name: CCA 101 除冰 4号引擎灭火失败

cards.audioText: B: You are at Beijing Airport, your call sign is CCA 101, there's ice accumulated on your plane, you want to have the ice removed before start-up. Contact Beijing Ground to request de-icing service.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你在 Beijing Airport，呼号 CCA 101，飞机上有积冰，想在开车前除冰。联系北京地面请求除冰服务。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA 101, there's ice accumulated on our plane, request de-icing service.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA 101，我们飞机上有积冰，请求除冰服务。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 101, Beijing Ground, where do you want to de-ice?
B: Tell Ground you want to de-ice on taxiway D7.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 101，北京地面，你想在哪里除冰？
B: 告诉地面你想在滑行道 D7 除冰。
cards.referenceText: Request to de-ice on taxiway D7, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求在滑行道 D7 除冰，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: B: Inform Ground de-icing completed on D7, ready to taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 通知地面，在 D7 除冰完成，准备滑行。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA 101, de-icing completed on D7, ready to taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA 101，D7 除冰完成，准备滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 101, taxi to holding point Runway 36R via W2, Z4 and B, caution, taxiway is covered with ice patches.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 101，经 W2、Z4 和 B 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，注意，滑行道有片状结冰。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 36R via W2, Z4 and B, roger, thanks, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 W2、Z4 和 B 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，收到，谢谢，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: B: Your de-icing fluid is only effective for 30 minutes, tell Ground that you need to take off before 0900 and request an intersection departure from Z4.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的除冰液只有效 30 分钟，告诉地面你需要在 0900 前起飞，并请求从 Z4 交叉口离场。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA 101, our de-icing fluid is only effective for 30 minutes, we need to take off before 0900, request intersection departure from Z4.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA 101，我们的除冰液只有效 30 分钟，需要在 0900 前起飞，请求从 Z4 交叉口离场。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 101, negative due sequencing, continue taxi to holding point Runway 36R via W2, Z4 and B.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 101，因排序原因不批准，继续经 W2、Z4 和 B 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Roger, continue taxi to holding point Runway 36R via W2, Z4 and B, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续经 W2、Z4 和 B 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CCA 101。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 101, stop immediately, a catering truck has just knocked an engine of your plane.
B: Ask Ground which engine it is.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 101，立即停止，一辆配餐车刚撞到了你飞机的一台发动机。
B: 询问地面是哪台发动机。
cards.referenceText: Roger, which engine has been knocked? CCA 101.

cards.audioText:
C: No.4, the right outboard engine.
B: Tell controller that you have to shut down all 4 engines and discharge fire extinguishers of engine number 4.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 4 号，右外侧发动机。
B: 告诉管制员你必须关停全部 4 台发动机，并释放 4 号发动机灭火瓶。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA 101, we have to shut down all 4 engines and discharge fire extinguishers of engine No.4.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA 101，我们必须关停全部 4 台发动机，并释放 4 号发动机灭火瓶。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, CCA 101, I'll send out the fire brigade.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 收到，CCA 101，我会派消防队。

cards.audioText: B: The fire cannot be extinguished, inform this to ATC, this is a Distress call, also you want to carry out evacuation and request emergency equipment.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 火无法扑灭，向 ATC 通知，这是遇险呼叫，同时你想进行撤离并请求应急设备。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Beijing Ground, CCA 101, the fire cannot be extinguished, we are evacuating, request emergency equipment.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，北京地面，CCA 101，火无法扑灭，我们正在撤离，请求应急设备。
